name: chaskyapp
description: CHASKYAPP — Red Privada de Mensajería Omnicanal con IA Local, Videollamadas WebRTC P2P y PWA Offline

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c green,blue "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c green,blue "cd server && node index.js" "cd client && npx vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173"
scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
